rationale: C18 is a direct and material drafting source. The child repeats nearly verbatim C18's three-part description of the Joint Federal-State Action Committee's responsibilities, then continues the same institutional narrative by reporting the Committee's creation, recommendations, and proposed implementation. This is distinctive shared language and the same administrative machinery, not merely a shared federalism topic. C06 and C22 are weaker parallels involving requests to Congress to implement committee recommendations and itemized accounts of implementation, but neither matches the child's distinctive language and specific institutional framework as closely as C18.

shared_material.child_excerpt: One--to designate functions which the States are ready and willing to assume and finance that are now performed or financed wholly or in part by the federal Government; Two--to recommend the federal and State revenue adjustments required to enable the States to assume such functions; and Three--to identify functions and responsibilities likely to require State or federal attention in the future...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: One--to designate functions which the States are ready and willing to assume and finance that are now performed or financed wholly or in part by the Federal Government; Two--to recommend the Federal and State revenue adjustments required to enable the States to assume such functions; and Three--to identify functions and responsibilities likely to require State or Federal attention in the future...
shared_material.explanation: The child reproduces C18's distinctive three-part mandate essentially verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This task force proposal was accepted by the Governors and in August of last year the Joint federal-State Action Committee was created, composed of ten Governors and seven federal representatives.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I proposed and the Governors adopted a resolution of acceptance that there be established a Joint Federal-State Action Committee with three basic responsibilities... [followed by appointment of the Governors and seven federal members].
shared_material.explanation: The child summarizes the institutional action established and staffed in C18, preserving the same federal-state committee machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Three of those recommendations requiring congressional action were that the federal Government... discontinue its grants... reduce its 10% tax... The Director of the Bureau of the Budget will transmit draft legislation...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the Committee should, in designating the functions to be reassumed by the States, also specify when those functions should be assumed, the amounts by which Federal taxes should be reduced, and increases in State revenues needed to support the transferred functions.
shared_material.explanation: The child's concrete legislative program implements the precise function-transfer and paired federal-tax-adjustment mechanism laid out in C18.
